description: Defines the interface for a multi-threaded proxy resolver factory in the Chromium project, including class declarations, methods, and thread management details.

classes.name: MultiThreadedProxyResolverFactory
classes.description: A factory class that creates proxy resolver instances capable of running on multiple threads, managing thread pool size, and handling proxy script resolution.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: A private nested class representing individual proxy resolution jobs within the factory.

methods.name: CreateProxyResolver
methods.description: Creates a new proxy resolver instance based on the provided PAC script, with callback and request management.

methods.name: CreateProxyResolverFactory
methods.description: Pure virtual method to create a new ProxyResolverFactory for spawning proxy resolvers.

methods.name: RemoveJob
methods.description: Removes a job from the factory's job set, managing cleanup.
